using System;
using System.Threading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Tsavorite.core;
using Xunit;

namespace Tsavorite.Tests
{
    public class DeltaLogTests
    {
        private class TestDevice : IDevice
        {
            public ulong SectorSize => 512;
            public long GetFileSize(int fileId) => 4096;
            public void ReadAsync(ulong offset, IntPtr buffer, uint length, Action<uint, uint, object> callback, object context)
            {
                // Simulate successful read
                callback(0, length, context);
            }
        }

        private class PageAsyncFlushResultEmpty : PageAsyncFlushResult<Empty>
        {
            public PageAsyncFlushResultEmpty()
            {
                count = 1;
            }
            public override void Free()
            {
                // no-op for test
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback_LogsError_WhenErrorCodeNonZero()
        {
            // Arrange
            var device = new TestDevice();
            var logger = new TestLogger();
            var deltaLog = new DeltaLog(device, 9, 0, logger);

            var flushResult = new PageAsyncFlushResultEmpty();

            // Act
            // Use reflection to invoke private method AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback
            var method = typeof(DeltaLog).GetMethod("AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            method.Invoke(deltaLog, new object[] { 123u, 0u, flushResult });

            // Assert
            Assert.Contains("AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback error: 123", logger.LastErrorMessage);
        }

        private class TestLogger : ILogger
        {
            public string LastErrorMessage { get; private set; }

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;
            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;
            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                if (logLevel == LogLevel.Error)
                {
                    LastErrorMessage = formatter(state, exception);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
